name: 75134 · Lancaster, TX
findings: ZIP 75134 (Lancaster) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75134 (Lancaster) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75134 (Lancaster) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 58% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
